job_description_text:
Software Engineer Intern – Job Description
Company: TechNova Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Bengaluru, India
Employment Type: Internship (Full-Time)
Duration: 6 Months
Stipend: ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month

About the Company

TechNova Solutions is a rapidly growing technology company focused on developing innovative software solutions for enterprises across healthcare, finance, education, and e-commerce sectors. We leverage modern technologies including Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, and Data Analytics to build scalable digital products.

Position Overview

We are seeking a passionate and motivated Software Engineer Intern to join our development team. The ideal candidate should possess strong programming fundamentals, problem-solving abilities, and an eagerness to learn modern software development practices.

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will collaborate with experienced developers to design, develop, test, and deploy software applications while gaining hands-on industry experience.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain web-based applications.
Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following industry best practices.
Collaborate with frontend and backend development teams.
Participate in Agile development processes including sprint planning and daily standups.
Develop and consume RESTful APIs.
Perform debugging, testing, and troubleshooting of applications.
Assist in database design and query optimization.
Participate in code reviews and implement feedback.
Create technical documentation for developed features.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and software development trends.

What You'll Learn
Industry-standard software development practices.
Agile and Scrum methodologies.
Cloud deployment and DevOps basics.
API development and integration.
Database design and optimization.
Full-stack application development.
Benefits

Certificate of Internship.

Access to technical training programs and workshops.
ATS Keywords

Software Development, Java, Python, C++, React.js, Node.js, SQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Git, GitHub, REST API, Docker, AWS, Cloud Computing, Data Structures, Algorithms, OOP, Agile, Web Development.

Avoid using tables in your resume — many ATS systems cannot parse table content correctly.
